p1c9.title: Nationalism, Reaction, and the New Luddites
p1c9.caption: Plate IX · The broken shuttle
p1c9.palette_role: Copper/seal — Luddite chapter runs hot; longest chapter (29,489 words) gets the densest plate. Copper #B26A3B leads frame/cartouche/beam work; Seal #9E3B2E carries the tear, severed warps, and snap (graphics only, never text).
p1c9.rationale: The chapter's load-bearing passage is the Luddite rising of 1811–12 (paras ~398–407): West Yorkshire croppers, General Ludd's 'Army of Redressers,' the oath to 'put down all Machinery hurtful to Commonality.' The loom is the honest Luddite artifact, and warp/weft line-work is native to engraving. The plate stages the book's own thesis — reactionaries smash the machinery of the information age — as a snapped shuttle tearing the fell line, flanked by WARP/WEFT rectilinear 9-petal rosettes (petal count = chapter IX, S4). The IBM 'Solutions for a small planet' trade-card line (para 4) anchors the plate footer as the small-planet provocation the Luddites answer.
p1c9.opener: Plate left (class plate): engraved loom — copper beams + 18 warps, 6 severed warps curling seal-red, jagged tear across the fell, broken boat-shuttle snapped in two with splinters and motion ticks; WARP/WEFT mini-rosettes flank the IX cartouche; assay bar 'ASSAYED 9 OF 11 · TWENTY-NINE THOUSAND WORDS'; footer 'GENERAL LUDD · ARMY OF REDRESSERS' + IBM trade-card line. Right: part line, Bodoni title, epigraph (Pfaff, paras 0–2) in copper rule frame.
p1c9.reading: Reaction episodes as dated broadsides (mono datelines: WEST YORKSHIRE 1811–12, etc.); Billig nationhood passages in quoted display; Ned Ludd oath (para 399) as centered broadside block; Quigley-style lists as assay tables; long-chapter relief via the sub-section transition system below (no single hero carries 29k words).

p1c10.title: The Twilight of Democracy
p1c10.caption: Plate X · Sundial at dusk
p1c10.palette_role: Copper/oxide dominant; bone text on deepened Vault ground. Copper #B26A3B leads dial/halo/cartouche; Specie gold only for the gnomon blade + assay (the instrument, not the light); Seal #9E3B2E carries the escaping dusk shadow (graphics only).
p1c10.rationale: Democracy's rarity and its megapolitical preconditions (Quigley weapons-conditions, paras 2–6; Toffler 'political expression of mass production,' para 22). Twilight = long shadows: the sundial literalizes the title without cliché sunset gradients. Ten hour lines = denomination X; the shadow escapes the dial rim (democracy outliving its conditions, spilling past the instrument that measured it). The halo guilloche ring is the chapter's 10-petal rosette (S4 — petal count = X, distinct copper halo geometry vs. the seals' discs and the loom's rectilinear minis).
p1c10.opener: Plate left (class plate): sundial — copper dial face with 10 engraved hour lines (XII..IIII) fanning from the foot, gold cross-hatched gnomon blade with apex dot, seal-red hatched dusk shadow escaping past the dial rim into the 10-petal halo guilloche; Toffler motto in Bodoni italic under the dial; X cartouche; assay 'ASSAYED 10 OF 11 · THREE CONDITIONS OF DEMOCRACY'; footer 'FRATERNAL TWIN OF COMMUNISM' + Quigley conditions line. Right: part line, Bodoni title, Pfaff epigraph (paras 0–1) in copper rule frame.
p1c10.reading: Quigley weapons-conditions (paras 3–5) as an engraved assay table (3 rows, mono numerals, hairline rules); numbered conditions as engraved list; marginal hour-ticks mark section breaks (small dial-tick ornaments at the major heads); hour-line motif recurs as the chapter end-mark (single gnomon tick).

p1c11.title: Morality and Crime in the “Natural Economy” of the Information Age
p1c11.caption: Plate XI · The counterfeit seal
p1c11.palette_role: Seal-red dominant — the ONLY chapter where red leads; gold demoted to the 'official' (defeated) layer. Seal #9E3B2E carries the counterfeit strike, XI cartouche, and colophon rule (graphics only, never body text); Specie gold holds the official seal + assay; Copper frames.
p1c11.rationale: Finale on covert criminal capture of the state — 'barbarians in disguise,' the Body Snatchers Pod People (paras 3–4), Tanzi's 'privatization of the state' epigraph (para 0). A misregistered second strike is the honest visual pun: counterfeit sovereignty overstruck on the official issue. Twin 11-petal rosettes (S4 — official = fine 11-lobe hypotrochoid guilloche; counterfeit = 11-SPIKE epitrochoid + dashed satellite, genuinely different geometry); whole-key vs. broken-key centres (trust vs. corrupted certification, para 228); stacked 1ST/2ND strikes with a shift-bridge caption so the misregistration reads intentional (S7), closed by a colophon bar: 'END OF THE ELEVEN.'
p1c11.opener: Plate left (class plate): two stacked seal strikes — gold OFFICIAL seal (fine 11-lobe guilloche, whole cipher-key centre, 'MINTED BY NO STATE · REDEEMABLE IN TRUST' microtext ring) above the seal-red COUNTERFEIT strike (11-spike rosette, dashed satellite, broken-key centre, 'LATTER-DAY BARBARIANS · IN DISGUISE' ring), joined by a shift-bridge ('2ND STRIKE · OFF REGISTER') with strike arrows; XI cartouche in seal red; assay 'ASSAYED 11 OF 11 · FINE'; colophon rule + 'END OF THE ELEVEN.' Right: part line, Bodoni title, Tanzi epigraph (para 0) as a stamped finding.
p1c11.reading: Blockquote findings in seal-red left rule; end-mark is the counterfeit seal glyph (small broken-key mark); appendix (paras 249–288) as numbered strategy ledger with mono clause numerals; footnote tail (para 289+) in the archive treatment below.

footnote_tail.note: Paras 289–827 (539 paragraphs) are the book's endnotes, headed 'Footnotes' (289) with per-chapter note headers at 290/318/346/392/462/489/544/569/609/740/781/825. The tail is reference matter, not reading prose.
footnote_tail.treatment: Archive treatment: 'Footnotes' head as an engraved archive divider (full-width lathe rule + Plex Mono 'ARCHIVE · NOTES 1–388' lockup); chapter note-headers (290/318/…) as mono ledger subheads with hairline rules; note paragraphs in reduced Source Serif size (0.9rem) with hanging numerals where present; tighter measure (60ch); faint Vault-elevated panel behind the tail section only; colophon end-mark closes the book. No drop caps, no ornaments inside the tail — quiet reference density.
